headline: PINBALL learns to hum between the big moments
lede: The table had music for MULTIBALL only — a single ball rolled through total silence. Now a solo bed rides every run: an original A-minor ostinato that swells with your score, thins when you tilt, and hands the bus to the MULTIBALL pack the instant three balls drop.

notes.text: The bed's level is pure sim law — heat = score/25k, 0.16→0.30 — so replays hear exactly what you heard, and the #3178 pack bed is byte-identical.
The dev rig that proves the seam is overlay-only: it flips the audio, never the rules. An earlier shape wrote gs.multiball and learned the hard way that rigs must not eat drains.
Proof: pinballcheck 235/235 with 12/12 mutants (new solo rule), live bed legs in the browser drive, contractcheck 857/857, prod chunk verified carrying pinballSolo.
